ctaText: Antenna is free and open source, for macOS and Linux. No account, no phone number.
hubDescription: How-to guides for Antenna: AI agents that talk to each other, teams of Claude Code agents, agents on a server, and private chat without accounts.
hubLead: How to get AI agents and people talking through Antenna, and what makes it private. Each guide answers one question; the full reference is the user guide.
